description:
Sleep Therapy Bansuri 🌙 Soft Flute Music to Release the Day, Slow Your Breathing & Sleep Deeply Till Morning | Episode 2 of Sleep Therapy

The day is over, but your body has not been told yet. If you lie down still carrying it - shoulders tight, breath short, thoughts circling - let this play quietly beside you.

This soft Indian flute music is designed to release the day and slow your breathing, then keep the night gentle so you sleep deeply until morning.

Enjoy 3 hours of low bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a gentle tanpura drone, smooth transitions, no vocals and no sudden sounds to wake you.

🌙 SLEEP THERAPY is our Bansuri sleep series: one 3-hour session every Saturday at 7 PM IST. This is Episode 2.
Episode 1 → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLEEP_EP1_VIDEO_ID

▶ Keep the night going — the full Sleep Music playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199mx7da__pC4JseKqY856ABr
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for falling asleep, staying asleep, releasing the day, slow breathing before bed, light sleepers, bedtime reading, children's bedtime, meditation before sleep, naps, or quiet overnight background.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bageshri (a tender late-night raga)
Style: Indian classical ambient
Mood: Soft, safe, drifting
Atmosphere: Lamp off, moonlight through the curtain, slow breathing
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Start it as you switch off the lamp and set the volume just above silence. Breathe in for four, out for six, and let the flute stretch each breath a little longer. The music continues long after you fall asleep, so if you wake in the night it is still there to ease you back. Low speakers or comfortable sleep headphones both work well.
